set.body: Use the opened 32-case cohort strictly as development material to explain why ordinary rigid results plateau around 0.4 to 0.8 mm and frequently end in trial exhaustion. Compare identity-start and truth-start runs, selected and last-valid checkpoints, independent landmark error, optimization versus selection objectives, and local finite differences at truth. Reduce the cause to a small JVM/Scala.js regression and make one narrow correction without loosening frozen tolerances or tuning on case identities. Fresh sealed qualification remains FA-L28.
set.title: FA-L29: Explain and correct the ordinary linear accuracy plateau
